title: GATE (Computer Science and Information Technology)
eligibility: Bachelor's degree or final-year student in engineering, technology or a related field. Always check the current brochure.
description: National entrance exam for M.Tech and PhD admissions and for several public-sector recruitment drives. Tests core computer science: algorithms, data structures, operating systems, databases, networks, theory of computation and engineering mathematics. Usually held once a year. The organising IIT changes every year, so this link points to the current cycle.

title: Google Summer of Code
eligibility: Students and early-career contributors aged 18 or over; rules change by year, so read the current eligibility page.
description: Paid, remote open-source mentorship. Contributors work on a real project with an experienced mentor over several months. Applications open once a year; early contributions to a project improve your chances.

title: ISRO Scientist/Engineer 'SC' recruitment (Computer Science)
eligibility: BE/B.Tech in Computer Science or a related branch with a minimum percentage set in each notification.
description: Government recruitment for scientists and engineers at ISRO centres. Selection is through a written test and an interview. Notifications are issued when vacancies arise, not on a fixed yearly calendar.

title: NIELIT Scientist and Technical Assistant recruitment
organisation: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT)
eligibility: Varies by post; typically a degree in computer science, IT or electronics. Read each notification.
description: Central government posts in IT and electronics training and research. Selection usually involves a computer-based test followed by document verification. Posts and dates vary by notification.

title: GATE (Mechanical Engineering)
eligibility: Bachelor's degree or final-year student in engineering or technology. Always check the current brochure.
description: National exam for M.Tech and PhD admission whose scores are also used by many public-sector companies for recruitment. Covers engineering mechanics, thermodynamics, machine design, fluid mechanics, manufacturing and engineering mathematics.

title: UPSC Engineering Services Examination (ESE)
eligibility: Engineering degree in the relevant branch; age and attempt limits apply. Check the current notification.
description: Recruitment exam for Group A engineering services in central government departments such as railways, roads and defence. Has a preliminary stage, a mains stage and a personality test.

title: SSC Junior Engineer (Mechanical)
eligibility: Diploma or degree in mechanical engineering as specified in each notification; age limits apply.
description: Junior engineer posts in central government departments and organisations. Selection is by written papers and document verification. Notification timing varies from year to year.

title: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)
organisation: Ministry of Education, Government of India
eligibility: Recent diploma and degree holders in engineering and technology; registration on the portal is required.
description: Government scheme for on-the-job apprenticeship training with a stipend at participating establishments. Graduates and diploma holders register on the portal and apply to listed establishments.

title: DRDO Scientist 'B' recruitment
eligibility: BE/B.Tech in the relevant engineering discipline; some posts use GATE scores. Read each advertisement.
description: Entry-level scientist posts at defence research laboratories. Recruitment is advertised periodically and may use GATE scores or a written test followed by an interview.

title: GATE (Civil Engineering)
eligibility: Bachelor's degree or final-year student in engineering or technology. Always check the current brochure.
description: National exam for M.Tech and PhD admission whose scores are also used for public-sector recruitment. Covers structural, geotechnical, water resources, transportation and environmental engineering plus engineering mathematics.

title: UPSC Engineering Services Examination (ESE), Civil
eligibility: Engineering degree in civil engineering; age and attempt limits apply. Check the current notification.
description: Recruitment exam for Group A civil engineering services in central departments such as railways, public works and water resources. Has a preliminary stage, a mains stage and a personality test.

title: SSC Junior Engineer (Civil)
eligibility: Diploma or degree in civil engineering as specified in each notification; age limits apply.
description: Junior engineer posts in central government departments such as public works, military engineering and water resources. Selection is by written papers and document verification; timing varies by year.

title: CPWD engineering recruitment
eligibility: Varies by post; typically a civil engineering degree or diploma. Read each notification.
description: Engineering posts in the department that builds and maintains central government buildings and infrastructure. Many posts are filled through UPSC and SSC; the department also publishes its own notices.

title: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)
organisation: Ministry of Education, Government of India
eligibility: Recent diploma and degree holders in engineering; registration on the portal is required.
description: Government scheme for paid on-the-job apprenticeship training. Civil engineering graduates and diploma holders register and apply to participating construction and infrastructure establishments.

title: GATE (Electronics and Communication / Electrical Engineering)
eligibility: Bachelor's degree or final-year student in engineering or technology. Always check the current brochure.
description: National exam for M.Tech and PhD admission and for several public-sector recruitment drives. Covers networks, analog and digital circuits, signals and systems, control, communications and electromagnetics.

title: UPSC Engineering Services Examination (ESE), Electronics and Telecommunication
eligibility: Engineering degree in the relevant branch; age and attempt limits apply.
description: Recruitment exam for Group A services in telecommunications, railways signalling and related central departments. Has a preliminary stage, a mains stage and a personality test.

title: ISRO Scientist/Engineer 'SC' recruitment (Electronics)
eligibility: BE/B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical or a related branch with a minimum percentage set in each notification.
description: Government recruitment for scientists and engineers at ISRO centres. Selection is through a written test and an interview. Notifications are issued when vacancies arise.

title: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) engineer recruitment
eligibility: BE/B.Tech in electronics, electrical, mechanical or computer science as specified per advertisement.
description: Public-sector defence electronics company that periodically recruits trainee and probationary engineers. Selection typically uses a written test and an interview.

title: DRDO Scientist 'B' recruitment (Electronics)
eligibility: BE/B.Tech in the relevant discipline; some posts use GATE scores. Read each advertisement.
description: Entry-level scientist posts at defence research laboratories working on radar, communications and embedded systems. Advertised periodically.

title: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)
organisation: Ministry of Education, Government of India
eligibility: Recent diploma and degree holders in engineering; registration on the portal is required.
description: Government scheme for paid on-the-job apprenticeship training in electronics and electrical establishments. Register on the portal and apply to listed employers.

title: IBPS Probationary Officer / Management Trainee (PO/MT)
eligibility: Graduate in any discipline; age limits apply. Check the current notification.
description: Common recruitment exam for officer posts in participating public-sector banks. Has preliminary and mains stages covering quantitative aptitude, reasoning, English, banking awareness and computer knowledge, followed by an interview.

title: IBPS Clerk
eligibility: Graduate in any discipline; local-language proficiency is required. Age limits apply.
description: Common recruitment exam for clerical posts in participating public-sector banks, with preliminary and mains stages. Usually held once a year. The organising IIT changes every year, so this link points to the current cycle.

title: IBPS RRB Officer Scale I and Office Assistant
eligibility: Graduate in any discipline; local-language proficiency is preferred. Age limits apply.
description: Common recruitment exam for officers and office assistants in regional rural banks. Preliminary and mains stages, with an interview for officer posts.

title: SBI Probationary Officer and Clerk recruitment
eligibility: Graduate in any discipline; age limits apply. Read the current advertisement.
description: India's largest public-sector bank recruits probationary officers and junior associates through its own exams. Stages include a preliminary test, a main test and further assessment for officers.

title: RBI Grade B Officer recruitment
eligibility: Graduate with a minimum percentage; some streams need a postgraduate degree. Check the current notification.
description: Officer recruitment for the central bank across general, economic and policy research, and statistics streams. Has multiple written phases and an interview.

title: NABARD Grade A (Assistant Manager) recruitment
organisation: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
eligibility: Graduate or postgraduate depending on the stream; age limits apply.
description: Officer recruitment for the apex development bank, covering rural development, finance and agriculture-related roles. Has a preliminary and a main stage followed by an interview.

title: CAT (Common Admission Test)
eligibility: Bachelor's degree with the minimum percentage set by the organising IIM; final-year students may apply.
description: The main entrance exam for IIMs and many other business schools. Tests verbal ability and reading comprehension, data interpretation and logical reasoning, and quantitative ability. Usually held once a year. The organising IIT changes every year, so this link points to the current cycle.

title: XAT (Xavier Aptitude Test)
eligibility: Bachelor's degree or final-year student. Check the current brochure.
description: Entrance exam for XLRI and many other management programmes. Includes decision making and general knowledge sections in addition to verbal and quantitative sections.

title: CMAT (Common Management Admission Test)
eligibility: Bachelor's degree or final-year student. Check the current information bulletin.
description: National-level entrance exam for management programmes at many AICTE-approved institutions. Covers quantitative techniques, logical reasoning, language comprehension and general awareness.

title: NMAT by GMAC
eligibility: Bachelor's degree or final-year student. Check the current registration page.
description: Entrance test for several leading business schools, taken within a registration window with multiple attempts permitted. Covers language skills, quantitative skills and logical reasoning.

title: SNAP (Symbiosis National Aptitude Test)
eligibility: Bachelor's degree or final-year student. Check the current brochure.
description: Entrance test for Symbiosis management institutes, held in more than one session. Covers general English, quantitative, data interpretation and analytical reasoning.

title: NEET-UG
eligibility: Class 12 with physics, chemistry and biology; age and attempt rules are in the current bulletin.
description: Single national entrance exam for admission to MBBS, BDS and other undergraduate medical courses. Tests physics, chemistry and biology. Held once a year.

title: NEET-PG
organisation: National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS)
eligibility: MBBS degree and internship completion as specified in the current bulletin.
description: National entrance exam for postgraduate medical (MD/MS) and diploma courses. Computer-based multiple-choice test across the MBBS syllabus. The schedule has varied between years.

title: INI-CET (AIIMS and other institutes of national importance)
organisation: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)
eligibility: MBBS or the required qualification for the course, as in the current notification.
description: Combined entrance test for postgraduate courses at AIIMS, JIPMER, PGIMER and other national-importance institutes. Held in more than one session per year.

title: AIIMS NORCET (Nursing Officer recruitment)
organisation: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)
eligibility: B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing or equivalent with registration, as specified in the notification.
description: Common recruitment test for nursing officers across AIIMS institutes. Computer-based test followed by further stages as notified. Timing varies by year.

title: FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination)
organisation: National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS)
eligibility: Medical graduates from foreign institutions who need to qualify to practise in India, as per the current rules.
description: Screening test for foreign medical graduates seeking registration in India. Usually conducted twice a year.

title: ICMR Junior Research Fellowship
eligibility: Postgraduate degree in the relevant life-science or medical field; details are in each announcement.
description: Fellowship for early-career researchers in biomedical and health research, awarded through a national entrance test. Supports a PhD at a recognised institute.

title: CLAT (Common Law Admission Test)
eligibility: Class 12 for undergraduate law; an LLB for the postgraduate test. Check the current notification.
description: Entrance exam for the national law universities and many other law schools. Tests English, current affairs and general knowledge, legal reasoning, logical reasoning and quantitative techniques.

title: AILET (All India Law Entrance Test)
eligibility: Class 12 for undergraduate law. Check the current information bulletin.
description: Separate entrance test for National Law University, Delhi, with sections on English, general knowledge, legal aptitude, reasoning and mathematics.

title: AIBE (All India Bar Examination)
eligibility: LLB graduates enrolled with a State Bar Council, as per current rules.
description: Qualifying exam that law graduates must pass to receive a certificate of practice from the Bar Council of India. It tests knowledge of core laws and professional ethics.

title: UGC NET (Law)
eligibility: Master's degree in law with the minimum marks in the current bulletin.
description: National eligibility test for assistant professor posts and for the junior research fellowship in law. Conducted twice a year.

title: NHRC internship programme
eligibility: Students of law and related subjects, as specified on the programme page.
description: Short internships at the national human rights body for students interested in human rights law and policy. Application windows and eligibility are published on the website.

title: CTET (Central Teacher Eligibility Test)
eligibility: Teacher-education qualification (such as D.El.Ed. or B.Ed.) as in the current notification.
description: Eligibility test for teaching at central government schools such as Kendriya Vidyalayas. Paper I is for classes 1 to 5 and Paper II for classes 6 to 8. Usually held twice a year.

title: UGC NET (Education and subject papers)
eligibility: Master's degree in the subject with the minimum marks in the current bulletin.
description: National eligibility test for assistant professor posts and for the junior research fellowship across subjects. Conducted twice a year.

title: Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) teacher recruitment
eligibility: Varies by post: degree plus B.Ed. and a valid CTET for most teaching posts. Read each notification.
description: Recruitment of primary, trained graduate and postgraduate teachers for Kendriya Vidyalayas across India. Selection uses a written test and an interview or demonstration.

title: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) teacher recruitment
eligibility: Varies by post: degree plus B.Ed. for most teaching posts. Read each notification.
description: Recruitment of teachers for Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, which are residential schools for talented rural students. Advertised periodically.

title: Tamil Nadu Teachers Recruitment Board (TN TRB) exams
eligibility: Varies by post; usually a degree, B.Ed. and TN TET where required.
description: Competitive exams for school and college teaching posts in Tamil Nadu, including the Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test. Notifications and dates vary by year.

title: UGC NET (JRF and Assistant Professor)
eligibility: Master's degree with the minimum marks in the current bulletin.
description: National test that qualifies candidates for the junior research fellowship, for assistant professor posts, or for PhD admission. Conducted twice a year across many subjects.

title: CSIR-UGC NET (science subjects)
eligibility: Master's or equivalent degree in a science subject, as in the current bulletin.
description: National test for the junior research fellowship and lectureship in chemical, life, mathematical, physical and earth sciences. Usually conducted twice a year.

title: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
organisation: Ministry of Education, Government of India
eligibility: Strong academic record and admission to a PhD at an eligible institution; check the current scheme guidelines.
description: Fellowship for top PhD candidates in science and technology at leading institutions, offering a monthly fellowship and research grant. Application windows vary.

title: INSPIRE fellowships and scholarships
eligibility: Differs by scheme (school, undergraduate, doctoral); read the current call.
description: Government programme that supports students in science through scholarships and fellowships, from undergraduate study to doctoral research. Calls are published on the portal.

title: Summer Research Fellowship Programme
eligibility: Students in science and engineering, as specified on the programme page.
description: Summer research placements that pair students with scientists at research institutions across India. Applications usually open in the early part of the year.

title: UPSC Civil Services Examination
eligibility: Bachelor's degree; age and attempt limits apply. Check the current notification.
description: The exam for the IAS, IPS, IFS and other all-India and central services. Has a preliminary test, a mains written exam and a personality test (interview). Held once a year.

title: UPSC Combined Defence Services (CDS)
eligibility: Degree requirement and age limits vary by academy. Check the current notification.
description: Entry route to the Indian Military Academy, Naval Academy, Air Force Academy and Officers Training Academy. Written test followed by an interview and medical examination. Held twice a year.

title: SSC Combined Graduate Level (CGL)
eligibility: Bachelor's degree; age limits vary by post. Check the current notification.
description: Recruitment exam for Group B and C posts in central ministries and departments. Has multiple tiers testing quantitative aptitude, reasoning, English and general awareness.

title: RRB NTPC (Non-Technical Popular Categories)
eligibility: Degree or Class 12 depending on the post; age limits apply.
description: Railway recruitment for posts such as station master, goods guard, clerk and accounts staff. Multi-stage computer-based tests. Timing varies by notification.

title: TNPSC Group 1, Group 2 and Group 4 exams
eligibility: Varies by group; degree for Groups 1 and 2, Class 10 for Group 4. Check each notification.
description: State government recruitment exams for administrative, executive and clerical posts in Tamil Nadu. Notifications and dates vary by year.

title: ICAR AIEEA-PG and AICE-JRF/SRF
eligibility: Relevant bachelor's or master's degree in agriculture and allied sciences, as in the current bulletin.
description: Entrance exams for postgraduate and doctoral admission in agricultural universities and for ICAR junior and senior research fellowships.

title: ASRB NET and Agricultural Research Service (ARS)
eligibility: Master's or doctoral degree in the relevant agricultural discipline; age limits apply.
description: National eligibility test for lecturer and assistant professor posts and recruitment exam for scientists in the ICAR research system. Dates vary by year.

title: NABARD Grade A (Rural Development) and agriculture-related officer posts
organisation: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
eligibility: Degree or postgraduate degree depending on the stream; age limits apply.
description: Officer recruitment at the apex development bank. Agriculture and allied degrees are eligible for several streams. Preliminary and main stages followed by an interview.

title: ICAR National Talent Scholarship
eligibility: Students admitted to agricultural universities through the national entrance route; see the current scheme guidelines.
description: Monthly scholarship for students at agricultural universities admitted through the ICAR entrance route, intended to encourage talented students to pursue agricultural education.
